04d2c57436.why: AVX2 cannot combine the eight required 256-bit stores, and both scalar updates and the final subtraction flags must be preserved.

19c3156fd9.why: The variable shift must produce the live rax value, and the unsigned high-word multiply followed by division by two cannot be combined for arbitrary input words.

62b72cbf84.why: All four broadcast results are live, requiring an instruction to write each destination register.

498c224f81.why: The eight full-width AVX2 stores and the two required scalar updates contain no removable instructions.

7780426b71.why: The four memory broadcasts produce live vector results, and all four stores and three scalar updates are required.

18ce482e7e.why: Each live broadcast result, row store, and scalar update already takes a single instruction.

fcb5d1fa8c.why: The four live 256-bit broadcasts, four separate row stores, and three scalar updates cannot be reduced under AVX2.

dc1a6a99f7.why: The broadcasts already fold their loads, while all eight full-width stores and three scalar updates are required.

ee2be119f9.why: The two live broadcasts, eight 256-bit stores, and three live scalar updates have no redundant work.

30a0371a13.why: Both loaded vectors, the word difference, and its absolute value are separate live results already produced with one instruction each.

1a270dbc1e.why: All six loaded, subtracted, and absolute-value vectors are live, so none of their producing instructions can be eliminated.

0133dd1f31.why: All twelve vector results are live, and AVX2 provides no operation that combines the required loads, differences, and absolute values while retaining each result.

c7cfd35c3e.why: AVX2 cannot place the memory operand in the minuend position, and preparing a shared negated subtrahend costs as many instructions as folding these two loads saves.

71d498ca6f.why: The broadcasts already include their loads, and AVX2 cannot fuse the rounded word multiplications with the subsequent additions or required stores.

6d169e6f3e.rewrite:
vpxor ymm0,ymm0,ymm0
vpsubw ymm0,ymm0,ymm5
vpaddw ymm3,ymm0,YMMWORD PTR [rdx+0x2]
vpaddw ymm4,ymm0,YMMWORD PTR [rdx+0x22]
vpaddw ymm6,ymm0,YMMWORD PTR [rdx+0x42]
vpaddw ymm7,ymm0,YMMWORD PTR [rdx+0x62]
6d169e6f3e.why: Compute the word-wise negation of ymm5 once in dead ymm0, then fold each original load into vpaddw. Addition of that negation equals the original subtraction modulo 65536 in every lane.

04ab3e0953.why: Every rounded product and addition feeds a required store, and both scalar updates are needed to preserve the final registers and flags.

bba5b2311b.why: The broadcast, arbitrary byte shuffle, and word arithmetic are necessary, while the live upper-lane extraction and four independently addressed stores cannot be removed.

ec4044881b.why: Both vector computations are required, and the upper-lane extractions are already folded into stores at their separate row addresses.

fbf8db589d.why: The subtraction before the shuffles depends on arbitrary ymm5 lanes, preventing replacement with simple word broadcasts, and all four subsequent products, sums, and stores are required.
